where.heritage: (UPPER(SCIENTIFIC) LIKE '%SEQUOIA%' OR UPPER(SCIENTIFIC) LIKE '%REDWOOD%' OR UPPER(COMMON) LIKE '%SEQUOIA%' OR UPPER(COMMON) LIKE '%REDWOOD%') AND STATUS <> 'Removed'
